name: openclaw-workspace
description: OpenClaw AI Assistant workspace with Discord, WhatsApp, and stock analysis tools

scripts.help:
echo '
=== Available Commands ===

Real-time Monitoring:
  npm run monitor        - Start real-time signal monitoring (5-min intervals)
  npm run monitor:once   - Run a single poll cycle
  npm run monitor:test   - Test with sample messages
  npm run monitor:status - Show monitor status

Historical Analysis:
  npm run historical     - Analyze last 1 day (default)
  npm run historical:day - Analyze last day
  npm run historical:week - Analyze last week
  npm run historical:month - Analyze last 30 days
  npm run historical:test - Test with sample data

Signal Validation:
  npm run validate       - Validate all pending signals
  npm run validate:auto  - Start auto-validation loop
  npm run validate:stats - Show validation statistics
  npm run validate:test  - Test with mock signal

Testing:
  npm run test           - Run all tests
  npm run test:analyzer  - Test message analyzer
  npm run test:generator - Test signal generator
  npm run test:memory    - Test trading memory
  npm run test:options   - Test options calculator
  npm run test:scenarios - Test predefined scenarios
  npm run test:integration - Test full pipeline

Utilities:
  npm run memory:stats   - Show trading memory stats
  npm run options        - Test options calculator
  npm run generate:signal - Test signal generator
'
